import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 10

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette("viridis", 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 100, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_counts = df.groupby('AlterVHundLang')['AnzHunde'].sum()
# Sort by age numerically
age_order = df.drop_duplicates('AlterVHundLang')[['AlterVHundLang', 'AlterVHundSort']].sort_values('AlterVHundSort')
age_counts = age_counts.reindex(age_order['AlterVHundLang'])
ax2.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm", len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Dogs in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette("mako", len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_yticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax3.set_yticklabels(district_counts.index)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution by Year
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_year = df.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'SexHundLang'])['AnzHunde'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
gender_year.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='white', width=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Year')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution Over Years', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper left')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
